findings.why_good: An open AI workbench built for real scientific workflows — AI-for-science is a large, underserved, high-value vertical where general chat tools fit poorly.
findings.value: Sell to labs / biotech / R&D as seats + compute + validated pipelines; science budgets are large and sticky once one workflow lands.
findings.risk: 'Workbench' is broad — it needs one killer, validated workflow to land; academic stars ≠ willingness to pay; parts overlap incumbents like Benchling.
